Elena (AE): Heads-up — Scout (prospect) wants to run a week-long internal trial of an unreleased community model (scarab-30b-x) and asked if we can support a few nonstandard needs.
Tom (Solutions Eng): Got it. What are the nonstandards?
Elena (AE): 1) 4k token seqs, 2) persistent KV cache across requests, 3) want metrics exported to their Prometheus. Also they asked about a one-off price for a small reserved pool during the trial.
Tom (Solutions Eng): 4k seqs + persistent KV is doable but depends on quant and batch settings. Which variant are they testing? scarab-30b-x (fp16) or the q4f16 fork?
Elena (AE): They gave a download link to scarab-30b-x-q4f16.tar.gz — says it's a community quant.
Priya (Inference Eng): q4f16 changes memory/perf. We need to verify attention kernels and KV layout. Can they provide model config (vocab, rotary dims, head count)?
Elena (AE): I asked for the config; they replied with a minimal config snippet and sample weights hash. Pasting what they sent:
```
model_name: scarab-30b-x-q4f16
vocab_size: 51200
hidden_size: 24576
num_heads: 64
rotary_dim: 64
seq_len_default: 4096
quant: q4f16
```
Tom (Solutions Eng): Thanks. Priya — rough gate: if kv-cache per-token memory fits within 48GB A40 style allocator after q4f16 we're fine for a small dedicated pool (1-2 instances). If not, fallback to 2k or split sessions.
Priya (Inference Eng): I'm running a quick estimate: KV memory ~ seq_len * hidden_size * 2 (key+value) * 4 bytes (float32) normally, but with q4 quant it compresses. Rough calc: 4096 * 24576 * 2 * 1 (~201M elements) -> ~201M bytes * factor. I'm going to run a micro-benchmark on our perf rig later today.
Dan (Security): Two security asks: 1) can we run in their VPC (Private deployment)? 2) will the model license allow enterprise use (we need a copy of the license text). Also they asked for SOC2-plus-ISO audit evidence — we can provide our audit pack but need to note Private has additional review.
Elena (AE): They prefer Hosted for speed but can do Dedicated if needed. They want an NDA + a short SOW for the trial.
Nadia (Pricing): For a week-long reserved pool (2 x 48GB GPUs with burst), we can quote a flat trial fee + usage overage. I'll draft a trial quote. Any constraints on ingress egress for embeddings/metrics?
Tom (Solutions Eng): Metrics export: we can push metrics via Prometheus remote_write to their endpoint. Need a short config:
```yaml
redwood_metrics:
  export: prometheus_remote_write
  url: https://prom-push.scout.corp/_push
  auth: bearer TOKEN
```
Elena (AE): They will host the endpoint and provide a token.
Priya (Inference Eng): Quick note on rollout: we should do a canary with model_variant: scarab-30b-x-q4f16 -> fallback scarab-30b-x-fp16 to avoid OOM/regressions. Canary config suggestion: 5% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 2 days. Also enable token-level tracing for the canary only.
Dan (Security): Legal wants the license before we let weights on Dedicated. If license prohibits commercial use we have to decline or limit to internal eval.
Elena (AE): I'll push license and SOW to the thread when I get it.
ops-bot: deployment-checklist created: #deploy-4356789012. Assigned to Priya and Tom. :white_check_mark:
Tom (Solutions Eng): I'll run the perf smoke and post numbers (p50 latency @ 1 rps, throughput @ 4k seq, cost estimate). ETA 6 hours.
Priya (Inference Eng): Running micro-bench now — will attach logs here when done. If q4f16 perf is unstable, propose we offer a prequantized variant from our catalog (scarab-30b-x-redwood-q4f16) that we support.
Nadia (Pricing): Drafting trial pricing, will include a clause for model variant vetting.
Elena (AE): Next actions I have: 1) push license + SOW 2) confirm NDA 3) sync with Scout on Prometheus endpoint. Tom/Priya — ping once perf + logs are in and I'll combine with Nadia's quote for legal.
Tom (Solutions Eng): ping received — will update thread.
Priya (Inference Eng): perf logs uploaded to #artifacts/4356789012/smoke.log — summary: q4f16 stable at 48GB with 1 rps, p95 ~ 420ms, KV memory ~ 36GB, batch=1. Notes: longer sessions may push >48GB.
Elena (AE): Good — Dan, is the SOC2 pack + audit statement ok to send for the trial?
Dan (Security): Yes, send SOC2 + ISO certs and our standard private-deployment checklist. We'll need to run a short network review for their VPC peering.
Elena (AE): Great. Marking this thread as active — will follow up once license arrives. :spiral_note_pad:
